subject.title: WhatsApp: Gemini thinking tags (<think>/<final>) still leak after #6328 fix

question: What should strict reasoning-tag stripping do when an unclosed `<think>` block contains a `<final>` boundary before delivery to messaging channels?
rationale: The current fallback intentionally recovers text from malformed unclosed tags, but the issue shows that this can expose hidden reasoning; changing it is a security and user-visible delivery policy choice rather than a safe mechanical cleanup.

options.title: Prefer final body, otherwise suppress
options.body: Update the shared sanitizer or stream parser to recover `<final>` content when present and otherwise drop unclosed thinking tails before channel delivery.

options.title: Channel-specific coordinators
options.body: Add WhatsApp and sibling-channel reasoning coordinators while leaving the shared strict fallback unchanged, accepting more duplicated channel logic.

options.title: Require live repro first
options.body: Keep current behavior until maintainers reproduce the exact current-main provider/channel path live, accepting the source-level leak risk in the interim.

recommendation.title: Prefer final body, otherwise suppress
recommendation.body: Update the shared sanitizer or stream parser to recover `<final>` content when present and otherwise drop unclosed thinking tails before channel delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the strongest current-history owner for the shared sanitizer and recent provider/reasoning-tag changes.
